post.summary: Sign in with phone number and password
post.description: Sets the session cookie. Five failed attempts in 15 minutes delay access for 15 minutes (ER-03-05). Attempts are counted per submitted phone number whether or not it is registered, and the delay answers 429 RATE_LIMITED, so the response never shows that a number exists.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

401.description: Wrong phone number or password. The same answer for unknown numbers.

429.description: Too many requests. Retry-After says when to try again.

post.summary: Request an OTP by WhatsApp for activation or recovery
post.description: Always answers 202 with the same body, so a phone number cannot be guessed (DEC-05). Limits: 60 seconds between requests and 5 per number per hour.

post.summary: Activate an account with a valid OTP and set the password
post.description: Recovery uses the same shape. A valid OTP ends all earlier sessions and OTPs. At most 5 wrong attempts per OTP.

204.description: Password set. The user signs in next.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

post.description: multipart/form-data with the photos in the same request, so there is no draft storage. The Idempotency-Key header makes a retry safe: the same key with the same content returns the stored ticket with Idempotent-Replayed: true.

200.description: A retry. The stored ticket is returned.

400.description: The request failed validation. Only field paths are returned.

404.description: The record does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

409.description: The same key is still being processed.

422.description: The key was already used for different content.

501.description: Draft contract. The endpoint is not implemented yet.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: One key per logical submission. Retry a timeout with the same key and identical fields/files. New submissions or changed content use a new key; resolve an uncertain earlier submission first.
